tasks.title: Establish modular project directory structure
tasks.description: Create the base project repository structure with separate directories for apps/web/api/worker, including placeholder files to confirm setup.

tasks.title: Create Dockerfiles for api, web, and worker apps
tasks.description: Develop Dockerfiles to containerize the api (FastAPI), web (Next.js), and worker (background jobs) components with appropriate base images and dependencies.

tasks.title: Set up docker-compose with PostgreSQL, Redis, and MinIO
tasks.description: Configure docker-compose to orchestrate containers for PostgreSQL database, Redis cache/queue, MinIO S3-compatible storage, and the three app containers (api, web, worker).

tasks.title: Implement core database schemas with SQLAlchemy and Alembic migrations
tasks.description: Define core domain models User, Asset, AssetVersion, TimelineEntry in SQLAlchemy and create Alembic migrations to set up initial tables in PostgreSQL.

tasks.title: Implement JWT authentication with user roles in FastAPI backend
tasks.description: Develop JWT-based authentication with refresh tokens, including user roles (admin, family member, child, guest) and role-based access control middleware for API endpoints.

tasks.title: Create upload pipeline skeleton for media assets
tasks.description: Implement API endpoints to accept image/audio/video uploads, save files in MinIO storage, store metadata placeholder in database, and create Asset and AssetVersion records.

tasks.title: Set up Dramatiq task queue using Redis broker
tasks.description: Integrate Dramatiq with Redis for async task processing in worker app and connect worker to API for enqueuing media metadata extraction jobs.

tasks.title: Implement media metadata extraction background jobs
tasks.description: Develop worker tasks to fetch uploaded media from MinIO, extract metadata using ffmpeg, Pillow, mutagen, and update AssetVersion metadata in the database.

tasks.title: Develop permission system for private, family, shared scopes
tasks.description: Implement framework in API backend to check and enforce asset permissions based on scopes for users across all relevant endpoints.

tasks.title: Build typed, versioned FastAPI RESTful API with OpenAPI docs
tasks.description: Define typed API endpoints for authentication, media upload, timeline retrieval, permission checks, and document API versions with OpenAPI specification.

tasks.title: Implement foundational timeline aggregation model
tasks.description: Develop backend logic to aggregate Assets, AssetVersions, and TimelineEntries into a unified timeline view respecting permissions and filter criteria.

tasks.title: Create Next.js frontend shell with authentication integration
tasks.description: Implement frontend authentication flows using JWT tokens from API, including login, logout, and protected routes with Tailwind and shadcn/ui components.

tasks.title: Implement basic photo gallery and music playback
tasks.description: Develop UI components for browsing photo gallery and playing music tracks with basic playback controls consuming API data.

tasks.title: Implement timeline navigation and filtering UI
tasks.description: Develop frontend timeline view with filtering by time ranges and asset types, integrating API timeline endpoints and updating UI accordingly.

tasks.title: Implement environment configuration and strict typing across codebase
tasks.description: Ensure all components (api, web, worker) use environment variables for config and enforce TypeScript/Python strict typing for code quality.

tasks.title: Dashboard shell: sidebar layout and navigation
tasks.description: Persistent left sidebar (project name, Timeline / Photos / Music, Logout); authenticated layout matches wireframe; nav wired to home dashboard and dedicated Photos/Music views without breaking protected routes.

tasks.title: Home dashboard: time-range strip, filtered photos, bottom player
tasks.description: Main dashboard stacks timeline range selector (e.g. months), photo grid filtered by selected interval, and compact audio player with track switching using existing API/BFF patterns.

tasks.title: Dashboard timeline: year selector plus twelve-month bar
tasks.description: Home timeline UX: choose calendar year then pick exactly one month on a horizontal twelve-segment bar; filters dashboard photos/player by captured_at for that month (refines T17 strip).

tasks.title: Dashboard timeline: years from captured_at data plus chevron month emoji strip
tasks.description: Year tabs only for years present in asset captured_at; chevron-shaped month segments with localized month name and seasonal emoji; empty library falls back to current year with hint.

tasks.title: Photos page: browsing and multipart upload
tasks.description: Photos route shows gallery plus upload form posting multipart to POST /api/v1/assets via authenticated BFF; refresh list on success; inline errors.
